fields.q: 这副伪装我也扮了好一阵子了。算是，嗯，习惯了。
fields.en: I have spent some time with this guise by now. I have, hmm, acclimated to it.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 这副伪装我也扮了好一阵子了。算是，嗯，习惯了。

en.value: I have spent some time with this guise by now. I have, hmm, acclimated to it.

fields.q: 我假扮传教士这么多年，这些单纯的野兽竟从不起疑。真是惊人。
fields.en: I have feigned the role of a missionary for years, yet these simple beasts do not question it. Amazing.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 我假扮传教士这么多年，这些单纯的野兽竟从不起疑。真是惊人。

en.value: I have feigned the role of a missionary for years, yet these simple beasts do not question it. Amazing.

fields.q: 你是最好的那种野兽，没有愚蠢的言语，也没有多余的动作。
fields.en: You are the best kind of beast, no foolish words or wasted actions.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 你是最好的那种野兽，没有愚蠢的言语，也没有多余的动作。

en.value: You are the best kind of beast, no foolish words or wasted actions.

fields.q: 是这片土地奇怪，还是我变奇怪了？我也说不清。
fields.en: Is this land strange, or have I become strange? I find I cannot say.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 是这片土地奇怪，还是我变奇怪了？我也说不清。

en.value: Is this land strange, or have I become strange? I find I cannot say.

fields.q: 你多美啊。拿来做我手术刀下的标本正合适，嗯？
fields.en: How beautiful you are. A fine specimen for my scalpel, hmm?
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 你多美啊。拿来做我手术刀下的标本正合适，嗯？

en.value: How beautiful you are. A fine specimen for my scalpel, hmm?

fields.q: 光是看到美的事物，心情就会变好。
fields.en: Simply catching sight of a thing of beauty is enough to lift the spirits.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 光是看到美的事物，心情就会变好。

en.value: Simply catching sight of a thing of beauty is enough to lift the spirits.

fields.q: 这片土地的阳光毫不留情。真希望有什么能挡一挡。
fields.en: In this land, the sun's rays are relentless. I wish for something to block them.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 这片土地的阳光毫不留情。真希望有什么能挡一挡。

en.value: In this land, the sun's rays are relentless. I wish for something to block them.

fields.q: 鞑古扎的植物让我很感兴趣。我还想观察、描绘更多。
fields.en: The plants of Dagda are of much interest to me. I would observe and sketch many more.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 鞑古扎的植物让我很感兴趣。我还想观察、描绘更多。

en.value: The plants of Dagda are of much interest to me. I would observe and sketch many more.

fields.q: 我不适合体力活。适合的人去做就好。这不是显而易见吗？
fields.en: I am ill-suited to physical labor. Those who are should be the ones to do it. Obvious, isn't it?
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 我不适合体力活。适合的人去做就好。这不是显而易见吗？

en.value: I am ill-suited to physical labor. Those who are should be the ones to do it. Obvious, isn't it?

fields.q: 那么，庆祝自己出生的日子到底有什么意义？我实在不明白。
fields.en: What, then, is the purpose of celebrating the day of one's birth? It escapes me.
fields.name: 法毕欧

q.value: 那么，庆祝自己出生的日子到底有什么意义？我实在不明白。

en.value: What, then, is the purpose of celebrating the day of one's birth? It escapes me.
